answer: Random beacon checks plus compute heartbeats block fake identities. Each identity locks 30 credits and sends a cipher-signed heartbeat every 30 minutes; the beacon audits 5% each epoch. One heartbeat is light as a zephyr for an honest worker, but a faker must run 100 streams for 100 copies. A missed heartbeat drops it to its nadir: deposit frozen 20 epochs, then burned. Forging 100 costs 3,000; one honest agent pays 30 once, rewards undiluted.
